added_lines: ). nominations requested for tawnawilly parish pastoral council (ppc) the parish pastoral council (ppc), which has been in place in our parish since 2023, is now renewing its membership and looking for new people to become involved. some existing members will step down, while those remaining will continue in their role, offering experience and continuity. new members will be welcomed and will bring new ideas and perspectives. this process of renewal helps to keep the council representative of the parish community and responsive to the current needs of the parish. the role of the ppc is to work alongside the parish priest fr. james, in addressing all aspects of the pastoral life of the parish including liturgy, formation, social activities and outreach. the ppc meet every four to six weeks from september to june each year. the council helps to identify the current and future needs of the parish and encourages people to become actively involved in the parish to support and strengthen our community of faith. if you wish to nominate someone who you feel would be suitable for this role, please put their name in the parish pastoral council suggestion boxes at the back of st. agatha’s church or st. patrick’s church. thank you, tawnawilly parish pastoral council healing sunday – rossnowlagh friary our healing service will be held this sunday, november 1st starting with rosary at 2.45pm and followed by mass/anointing at 3pm. confessions before and after the service. all welcome. the children’s rosary 7pm - the children’s rosary will continue for the month of november. the children will learn how to pray the stations of the cross for our dead. the rosary will take place in st. patrick’s church every wednesday evening at 7pm. scoil aodh rua agus nuala is taking enrolments for junior infants from 2nd oct. 2026 to 20th nov. 2026. application forms are available from the school office by telephone on

november novena for the holy souls the novena for the holy souls will take place in the parish from monday 2nd november and conclude on thursday 12th. the novena will be held in each church on the following days: st. agatha’s : mon. 2nd, wed. 4th, fri. 6th, mon. 9th, and wed. 11th. st. patrick’s : tues 3rd, thurs 5th, tues 10th and thurs. 12th. all the masses for the novena will take place at 7. 00pm . the november envelopes are now available in each church if you wish to use them to have a deceased person included in the novena. there are boxes in each church for you to place the november envelope when it is completed. photo’s : if there is someone in your family who has died during the past year in the parish (since 1st november 2025) we will be remembering them in a special way during the novena. we ask that you bring in a framed photo of the person who died and it will be placed on display during the novena as a way for the parish to remember and pray especially for them at this time. we ask that you bring in the photo before the first novena mass to either st. agatha’s or st. patrick’s church and give it to the sacristan, or you can drop it into the parish office on or before monday 2nd nov. thank you. the raphoe diocesan society was founded in 1874. in nov. of each year an annual mass for the deceased members of the society is offered in a different parish. annual rds mass for 2026 will be in st columba's church, glenswilly tues. 17th nov. at 7.30pm celebrant: most rev niall coll, bishop of raphoe. to enrol a person in the rds contact your local priest or email:
